"still allowing parent orchestrator nodes whose unresolved interrupts belong solely to descendant dynamic nodes to rerun and advance unblocked children" (pull request message)
metadata.rationale: A parent that runs two interrupting child nodes one after the other must still advance to the second child once the first is answered, and finish with both answers.

metadata.citation: "still allowing parent orchestrator nodes whose unresolved interrupts belong solely to descendant dynamic nodes to rerun and advance unblocked children" (pull request message)
metadata.rationale: A parent whose two parallel children both interrupt must wait through a partial answer and complete once the second child is answered.

metadata.citation: "require direct_unresolved to be empty before rerunning a rerun_on_resume node when unresolved interrupts remain" (pull request message)
metadata.rationale: A node with three simultaneous questions answered one at a time must hand its combined answers to the next step exactly once, after the last answer.

metadata.citation: "wait for all direct interrupts before rerunning rerun_on_resume nodes" (pull request title)
metadata.rationale: A node that asks its own question and then runs a child that asks another must carry both answers through to its final output.
